released_appids.name: The Memory Library
released_appids.description: Found the card you need? Then combine it. Even a card that looks completely useless might become surprisingly useful once you combine it. Probably. Collect and synthesize cards, create unexpected synergies, and take on 10 story chapters and an endless dungeon.

released_appids.name: SHINRAI Saku - Blooming Beyond Despair
released_appids.description: A month has passed since the tragic events at the Miyamoto Mountain Resort, which still weigh heavily on Raiko and her friends. Explore the challenges they face while trying to return to an ordinary life in this follow-up to the visual novel SHINRAI - Broken Beyond Despair.

released_appids.name: Warrior Spirits
released_appids.description: A martial arts card battler inspired by one of my favorite childhood games. Experience a story-driven adventure, level up your fighters, build your deck, shape your playstyle with stat upgrades, conquer roguelike runs, battle Raid Bosses, and fight players around the world in online pvp.

released_appids.name: LEARNING ROGUE
released_appids.description: A learning roguelike where solving questions powers every adventure. Answer problems, collect cards, build your deck, and explore school-themed worlds. Includes varied challenge modes and mini-games, full Xbox controller support, and no daily play-time limit in this paid edition.

released_appids.name: DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite
released_appids.description: CAVE's arcade bullet hell shooter returns as DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite. New stages, a new character, new music, and other new elements set the stage for a new challenge.

released_appids.name: COCORO
released_appids.description: "Please make me human." A visual novel about a robot longing to become "human" in a world torn apart by rampaging AI. An unforgettable summer unfolds between a boy who has nowhere to call home and a humanoid girl who dreams of marriage...

released_appids.name: Memory Brew: Tales of Underworld
released_appids.description: 一款带有模拟经营元素的纯狱系调饮类视觉小说。玩家扮演新孟婆“小孟娘”，在熟悉又陌生的现代地府中经营汤屋，招待来自三界形形色色的客户。通过熬制各种特调汤品，解决各式千奇八怪脑洞大开的遗忘需求，并逐渐了解到自己失忆和老孟婆失踪的真相……欢迎来到孟婆靓汤！这里的宗旨是——“忘陈莫急”！

released_appids.name: BOMBER-ANGEL BOMBRIEL -FOREVER THE KINGS-
released_appids.description: Bomber Angel Bombriel – FOREVER THE KINGS – is a top-down free-scrolling bomb-placement action/shooter that shares the same lineage as classic masterpieces like RoboWarrior (NES). It’s a fresh new game dressed in pastel, cute visuals—nostalgic in spirit, yet with noticeably improved controls.

released_appids.name: 捉迷藏 - Hide and Seek
released_appids.description: 长泽小学的一年级女生结奈，和青梅竹马的好朋友真也约好了一起玩捉迷藏。但是，最近他们的身边似乎出现了可疑的人物，街道的氛围也变得紧张了起来。即便如此，今天放学后也要去公园玩捉迷藏哦……

released_appids.name: How to Write a Book without Getting Killed
released_appids.description: Play as an author's assistant and follow her through five different worlds in search of a story. Fight dragons, solve puzzles and save a space station in this humorous RPG with turn-based combat and a touch of romance.

released_appids.name: Fractured Universe
released_appids.description: A Turn based RPG with a focus on team building and character development. Explore the Fractured Universe, and what life would be like if the multiverse was destroyed. Featured various art styles and aesthetics.

released_appids.name: VCuber
released_appids.description: Control the light ball and crush the bricks! Nara the girl can destroy the bricks by hitting the light ball and controlling its direction of movement, using the ball to clear all the bricks in the scene, but be careful of the enemies and their bullets.

released_appids.name: My Adorable Ghost Story
released_appids.description: A cowardly ghost needs your help to find peace. Complete his final wishes, get closer to him, and unravel the mystery of his death as you search for your own freedom in this short, story-driven adventure.

released_appids.name: GF Clicker
released_appids.description: A cozy idle clicker about winning someone over — one click, one gift, one new outfit at a time. Play it actively, leave it running, or just check in once a day. Low stakes, oddly satisfying.

released_appids.name: Palland: Creature Tamer World
released_appids.description: 🌍 Explore strange worlds, tame magical creatures and fight through chaos! Palland: Creature Tamer World - where every creature can become your fiercest ally... or your greatest threat. ⚔️✨

released_appids.name: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread
released_appids.description: Embark on a journey to reunite with your bread in this bite-sized 3D action-platformer featuring everyone's favorite shark!

released_appids.name: Project II: Silent Valley
released_appids.description: Project II: Silent Valley is a linear, semi-open world dystopian visual novel with card combat and explore. Play as US Navy Officer Hierophan, joining the docile humanoid weapon Osprey to uncover a conspiracy at the underwater base "Silent Valley" and the hidden truths of his missing friend, Ochira.

released_appids.name: Race Jam
released_appids.description: Experience the thrill of the 1990s with Race Jam - an action packed arcade-style racing game! Featuring retro-inspired tracks, high speed gameplay and an authentic throwback vibe. Race Jam: Exhilarating 90's Arcade Racing like you remember, But BETTER

released_appids.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS
released_appids.description: The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

released_appids.name: Saga of Yurina
released_appids.description: A Katana-parrying action Metroidvania set in an era of falling cherry blossoms! Defeat your foes with pure, flawless swordplay and prove your absolute mastery.

released_appids.name: Arena Blues - Requiem for 35
released_appids.description: Set in a medieval Roman arena, this is a simultaneous turn-based psychological strategy game. Experience intricate and intense combat based on weapon physics and realistic collision detection. Choose 3 out of 15 slave gladiators, each with their own unique backstory, to form your team.

released_appids.name: Running Late
released_appids.description: Follow Ayumi, a Japanese schoolgirl who's running late for school. In this fast-paced platformer, rush through the city avoiding obstacles, picking up power-ups, and taking every opportunity to run faster. Make it to school before the clock strikes eight to win!

released_appids.name: bansoko: Class Crossing
released_appids.description: An RPG-style party-following puzzle game. Your companions carry out your commands with a delay. Class-change with cute costumes!

released_appids.name: Dice Chemist
released_appids.description: A dice-poker roguelike where lucky rolls become alchemical combos. Roll, hold, and chain catalyst synergies to clear twelve rounds — and beyond.

released_appids.name: Mahjong King
released_appids.description: Mahjong King is an independently developed mahjong game—free to play! It features a clean, elegant UI with an anime-style aesthetic, and character voices are customizable!Click to install and play for free!

released_appids.name: Sevendays Demo
released_appids.description: SevenDays is a single‑player role‑playing RPG. Through your choices and interactions with a wide range of characters, you will unlock different endings. Their fates are interconnected, and a deep‑rooted conspiracy and hidden truth may lie beneath everything.

released_appids.name: 姑苏恋语 Demo
released_appids.description: 《姑苏恋语》是一款极具特色的视觉小说游戏，将恋爱、喜剧元素巧妙融合，以苏州为故事发生地，为玩家带来一场别具一格的本土恋爱体验。 游戏采用独特的二次元画风，画面细腻真实，对苏州的实景进行高度还原，每一个场景都仿佛能让人感受到这座江南古城的独特韵味，大眩光和大对比度的场景，增强视觉冲击力和真实感。

released_appids.name: The Windzen Legend Demo
released_appids.description: In a world covered by endless water... Join some new friends on an old adventure! Patricia and AutoBolt brave the ruins underneath Yasmar Island. Battle ancient machines and awesome Air-Pirates!

released_appids.name: Apocalypse Elysium Demo
released_appids.description: A turn-based tactical RPG where two students from modern Japan are pulled into a world at war. Move units across grid maps, exploit terrain and weapon matchups, and build a party of knights, blacksmiths and swordsmen. The story is told through dialogue alone, with no narration at any point.

released_appids.name: Auspicious Clouds
released_appids.description: A unique turn-based game featuring Auspicious Cloud Cards. Wield the power of the Five Elements to unleash skills and vanquish foes. Unlock a vast roster of character skills, collect Cultivation Orbs, and devise your own one-of-a-kind tactics to conquer every opponent.

released_appids.name: Shiba Heroes Demo
released_appids.description: Choose a Shiba hero, upgrade your battle deck, level up and progress through the map taking right decisions and winning turn-based card battles to unravel the mystery of the meme curse.

released_appids.name: Canvas City Demo
released_appids.description: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on roller skates. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

released_appids.name: Black Lotus Demo
released_appids.description: Transported into a dark fantasy novel, Lin Tangtang must navigate dangerous missions, tangled relationships, and fate-changing choices. Win the trust of the enigmatic Shen Run, uncover hidden secrets, and shape your own ending in this choice-driven visual novel.

released_appids.name: Until I Reclaim It Demo
released_appids.description: Set during the Japanese colonial period, this first-person visual novel follows a story where personal choices to protect a loved one conflict with the turbulent tides of the independence movement. Experience a deeply immersive historical narrative driven by consequential choices.

released_appids.name: Full Circle Demo
released_appids.description: If fate was already written, would you still fight to change it? Full Circle is a JRPG inspired by the classics of the PS1 era, set in a world where humanity fled to the skies in an attempt to outrun their destiny.

released_appids.name: Rinha de Waifus Demo
released_appids.description: Be the strategist behind cute waifus fighting in a tactical, chaotic auto battler: set your formations, pick each one's playstyle, then watch it all go gloriously wrong! Solo campaigns and challenges, online 1v1s against friends, and a ranked Arena for the ambitious.

released_appids.name: BAD STUDENT LOVE Demo
released_appids.description: Labeled a “troublemaker,” you transfer to the worst high school. There, you become entangled in dangerous relationships driven by desire, jealousy, and manipulation. Will you get closer, be used, or get hurt— your choices will determine how your story with them ends.

released_appids.name: World of Slime Demo
released_appids.description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

released_appids.name: 环梦症 Demo
released_appids.description: This is a visual novel with a hybrid pixel art style. From the protagonist's perspective, you recall fragments of the past and unravel the spiral of tragedy and silence. When the boundary between dreams and reality grows blurred and fragile, will you make the same choice as him?

released_appids.name: БЛОК 200: Пролог Demo
released_appids.description: A visual novel in the Samosbor setting. You are a student of the technical college who wakes up in a stranger's hab-cell after your own death. You must come to terms with your new grim nature and face the cruel world far from the walls of your native incubator block.

released_appids.name: Phantom Cardia: Astral Card Duel Demo
released_appids.description: Phantom Cardia is an offline turn-based deck-building RPG. Build a 30-card deck from 168 cards across six Academies. Battle through a 60-node campaign, roguelike trials, the Eight Sovereigns boss rush, Astral Arena, and Free Battle. Reshape cards with Startrace Fusion and reclaim lost memories.

released_appids.name: 迷家mygohome Demo
released_appids.description: mygohome is a Lovecraftian psychological horror game. A remote town is being consumed by an unknown presence. You awaken in a strange room. Something is drawing near. Survive five nights. Your only companion is a rabbit doll. It knows everything. But can you trust it?

released_appids.name: How to grow a man Demo
released_appids.description: Raise Chris over four years, shape his future, and pursue romance with seven unique men in this BL life and dating simulation. Your choices determine his career, relationships, and ending.

released_appids.name: Mile High Walkout Demo
released_appids.description: Lead 4,200 cabin crew through a volatile airline strike as union president Rowan Petrak. Navigate public pressure, hard negotiations, and three distinct romance routes where loyalty, credibility, and personal choices shape multiple endings.

released_appids.name: Anabiosis Demo
released_appids.description: Awaken in an unfamiliar apartment. Explore, survive, and discover how to escape.

released_appids.name: The Demon Lord's Maid Cafe Demo
released_appids.description: Take my order, brother! The Demon Lord's Maid Cafe is a short cafe-themed incremental game about feeding slimes in a Maid Cafe. Buy upgrades, feed slimes, and take your Maid Cafe to the top.

released_appids.name: Touhou Bansho Cards ~ Demo
released_appids.description: Fight to the end! Once a card is played, don't stop. Push the Combo higher, break the damage limit, and blast through anything in your way! Touhou Bansho Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect cards, explore the Bansho Card Corridor, defeat Echoes, rescue Gensokyo's girls, uncover the truth.

released_appids.name: DmonMaster Demo
released_appids.description: A Grind-Free 3v3 Auto Battle Hack-and-Slash Game about collecting the 100 Dmon who rule the Code of the world!

released_appids.name: The Passing Bell Demo
released_appids.description: You awaken in an ever-shifting manor with no memory of who you are. As you explore its corridors, you encounter a disfigured man, an arrogant scientist, and a faceless doll waiting for someone in a greenhouse. Uncover the tragic link between them.

released_appids.name: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines） Lite
released_appids.description: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

released_appids.name: BomberBird
released_appids.description: Play as members of Dokibird's Dokiverse in this Bomber inspired action game! Drop egg bombs across the battlefield, get powerups, choose your path through the levels and go head to head with bosses! Be the last one standing before the time runs out!

released_appids.name: Send Forth the Brave Demo
released_appids.description: Roguelike deckbuilder where you run an Adventurers’ Guild. Combine heroes, weapons, and items into teams, fulfill quirky commissions, deal with difficult clients, and build the most powerful guild in the realm.
